title: Mouse Pancreatic Islet Isolation
author: Nancy Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sqaedse
materials: After isolation, allow digestion to proceed for 7 minutes (lot specific -Sigma C9263 lot 010M8620 ) in shaking water bath at 37°C. 00:07:00 37 °C

steps.title: Prepare Powdered Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the base medium by dissolving powdered medium in 900ml of room temperature H2O.

substeps.instruction: Gently stir the water while adding the powdered medium until dissolved; do not heat.
Rinse the original vial with water to remove traces and add the rinse to the solution.

steps.title: Finalize Medium Preparation
steps.instruction: Add sodium bicarbonate and supplements to the medium.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.35g sodium bicarbonate and stir until dissolved.
Add FBS and Pen/Strep to the bottle of RPMI.
Store the medium at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Collagenase Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh collagenase solution in HBSS immediately before isolation.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve collagenase to a concentration of 1mg/ml in HBSS.
Prepare approximately 5ml per mouse for injection and shaking.
Keep the solution on ice and use within one hour.

steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Isolation
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse and expose the pancreas.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mouse according to institute research ethics protocols (e.g., CO2 chamber).
Make a midline incision from the lower abdomen to the sternum.

steps.title: Inject Collagenase
steps.instruction: Perform in situ digestion of the pancreas.

substeps.instruction: Tie or clamp the common bile duct where it meets the intestine.
Inject collagenase via the common bile duct using a 30G needle until the pancreas is inflated (typically 1-2 mL), ensuring both the head and tail are inflated.

steps.title: Excise and Digest Pancreas
steps.instruction: Remove the pancreas and complete the digestion process.

substeps.instruction: Remove the pancreas and place it in a tube (15mL or 50mL) with the remaining collagenase (1-2mL).
Keep the tube on ice until the next step.
Shake the digested material vigorously.

steps.title: Stop Digestion and Initial Cleanup
steps.instruction: Terminate the enzymatic digestion and clear debris.

substeps.instruction: Add Mouse Islet Media to stop digestion.
Keep tubes on ice until ready for purification.
Allow islets to settle for 2-3 minutes and remove excess fat.

steps.title: Purify and Culture Islets
steps.instruction: Purify the isolated islets and place them in culture.

substeps.instruction: Purify islets using the histopaque gradient protocol or by hand picking.
If hand picking: pour islets into a non-tissue culture dish and pick islets into a 35mm non-tissue culture dish.
Culture the picked islets using Mouse Islet Media at 37°C and 5% CO2 until ready for use.
